title: Andaman Creole Hindi
description: Trade language of the Andaman Islands, India
extract: Andaman Creole Hindi is a trade language of the Andaman Islands, spoken as a native language especially in Port Blair and villages to the south. Singh (1994) describes it as a creolization of Hindi, Bengali and Tamil.
